# Civic Operator

> Civic Operator publishes an independent reference layer for the CMS Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP) — the $50B state-awarded program created by Section 71401 of the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. For all 50 states it records the exact Year-1 federal award, the administering agency, how each state defines "rural", the performance metrics each state committed to CMS, official .gov sources, and a dated activity log.

- Every page has a clean Markdown companion at the same URL with `index.md` appended, or via `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation.
- Figures are transcribed from state project narratives and CMS award documents; each state page cites its official .gov sources.
- State award amounts are CMS Year-1 obligated figures unless stated otherwise.

## Start here

- [Civic Operator — Operations, delivered as software](https://www.civicoperator.com/): Civic Operator is the consulting practice of Daniel X. O'Neil. I build the systems that public-health departments, nonprofits, media, and other complex organizations run on.

## Rural Health Transformation Program

- [2026 Q2 Newsletter Activity Index](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/activity/): Every state activity item we logged this quarter — 441 items across 47 states — each linked to its newsletter post.
- [Additional Briefs · RHT Data Consulting](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/additional/): Order an additional State Fit Brief — another entity, additional states, or a refreshed read as the program moves — at $500 each, paid via Stripe.
- [Q2 RFP Review / Q3 RFP Watcher · Rural Health Transformation](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/dashboard/): Quarterly dashboard for the $50B CMS Rural Health Transformation Program — Q2 RFP review and Q3 procurement watch, with a 50-state map, analytics, and a source-linked procurement catalog.
- [RHTP Verified Intelligence · RHT Data Consulting](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/intelligence/): A standing arrangement built on one program: a machine pointed at the $50B Rural Health Transformation Program across all fifty states, and a person who reads what it surfaces before it reaches you — with published contacts and where to read the source. From $2,000 a month, month to month.
- [Rural Health Transformation](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/): Everything on the $50B CMS Rural Health Transformation Program in three layers: a free state-by-state reference, the Grant Tracker newsletter, and consulting — from a one-time State Fit Brief to RHTP Verified Intelligence, a per-client, human-verified morning digest of RHTP opportunities.
- [Rural Health Transformation Program — State-by-State Reference](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/): An independent, state-by-state reference for the $50B CMS Rural Health Transformation Program: exact Year-1 federal awards, administering agencies, how each state defines rural, the metrics states committed to CMS, official .gov sources, and a dated activity log for all 50 states.
- [What's in a State Fit Brief · RHT Data Consulting](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/brief/): A State Fit Brief is a ranked, ten-state document that shows where your platform fits the $50B Rural Health Transformation Program — why, what's being procured, when it opens, and who to talk to.

## RHTP cross-state reference

- [How every state defines rural for its Rural Health Transformation Program](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/rural-definitions/): How each U.S. state defines “rural” for its CMS Rural Health Transformation Program — own definition, county list, or federal HRSA default — with each state's rural share on a common federal baseline, a link to its source, and a gallery of the 15 authentic state-published rural maps. By Civic Operator.
- [Methodology & Sources — RHTP State Reference](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/methodology/): How the Civic Operator Rural Health Transformation Program state reference is sourced, derived, updated, and maintained — and how it separates neutral reference from newsletter analysis.
- [RHTP administering agency for every state](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/agencies/): The state agency administering each state's CMS Rural Health Transformation Program, with a link to its official .gov hub. All 50 states, by Civic Operator.
- [RHTP outlays by state — federal money actually disbursed](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/outlays/): How much CMS Rural Health Transformation Program money has actually been disbursed (outlaid) to each state versus obligated — all 50 states, pulled weekly from USASpending.gov. Current as of 2026-09-17, by Civic Operator.
- [Test Run Pilot Rural Health Transformation Program — CMS award, lead agency, committed metrics & activity](https://www.civicoperator.com/work/rht/states/test-run-pilot/): Test Run Pilot's CMS Rural Health Transformation Program at a glance: the exact Year-1 federal award, administering agency and contacts, how the state defines rural, the metrics it committed to CMS, official .gov sources, and a dated activity log. Independent reference by Civic Operator.
